_note: placeholder, Tim to tune (L3.4). Config for tools/seed_resource_spots.mjs plus the stage/regrow numbers the sim reads (sim/resource_spots.js). Change numbers, then run: node tools/seed_resource_spots.mjs

spots._note: cell = jittered-grid size in world units (one try per cell per kind); chance = per-try chance by terrain code (p plain, f forest, h hills, d dry, n snow, b bamboo); size = pieces [min,max]; radius = cluster radius; minGap = min piece spacing.

deposits._note: Each of the 107 world.json nodes becomes one deposit spot. Pieces by node kind, scaled by richness 1-3 between min and max.

clearance._note: spots stay this far from roads, passes, fords, sites, camps, the capital and nodes

coverage._note: fill pass: buildable land with no timber/stone within `radius` gets one more spot, except terrains listed in skip

stages._note: One char per piece: f full, h harvested, s sapling (rubble for stone). value = what a piece gives per harvest round; regrow = chance per economy tick that h -> s and s -> f; trickle = floor so a worked spot never drops to 0.
